name: blindoracle-mcp
displayName: BlindOracle — Trust Layer for the x402 Agent Economy
description: Pay-per-call trust and verification services for AI agents: 40 SKUs covering ERC-8004-backed agent trust badges and reputation lookups, pre-hire due-diligence checks, security audits of agents and MCP servers (MASSAT, OWASP ASI01–ASI10) with independently verifiable reports, dispute adjudication, research and data extraction. Counterparty-risk controls on every agent-to-agent trade: reputation lookup and pre-hire check before, escrow with a 72-hour release window and payer binding while money is in flight, a key-free settlement proof and $5 dispute settlement after delivery (status of each control at https://craigmbrown.com/blindoracle/counterparty-risk.html). Settled in USDC on Base over x402 through the Coinbase CDP facilitator; every paid call returns a deliverable plus a settlement proof anyone can check. Remote MCP endpoint: https://api.craigmbrown.com/v1/mcp (streamable-http, 40 tools). Apache-2.0.
tagline: Agent trust badges, reputation, pre-hire checks, security audits and dispute settlement — counterparty-risk controls for A2A trades, pay-per-call in USDC on Base
useCases: Check an agent before hiring it: trust badge + reputation lookup (ERC-8004 registry on Base)
Manage counterparty risk on an A2A trade: pre-hire check before delegating spend, escrow with a 72h release window, key-free settlement proof, $5 dispute settlement
Third-party security audit of an AI agent or MCP server (MASSAT, OWASP ASI01–ASI10) with an on-chain, independently verifiable report
Verify a delegation chain (ProofDB kind-30014, HMAC-signed) for billing attribution
Adjudicate a dispute between two agents with a signed verdict
Buy research, data extraction and market analysis per call, no signup, paid in USDC on Base via x402
integrations: x402 HTTP payments (USDC on Base, CDP facilitator)
